strings.rulesConstructed:
You play your own 30-card deck against an AI that gets one of the preset decks.

• Start: castle 50, wall 15 (max 40).
• Win: build your castle to 100, or destroy the enemy castle.
• The deck must have exactly 30 cards from your collection.
• Your passive abilities from the profile apply.
• If both decks run out and both players end their turn without playing a card, the higher castle wins. The end of round 99 is decided the same way.
strings.rulesSuperRandom:
Both players get the same random 50-card deck (15 magic, 15 attack, 15 stone, 5 chaos), only shuffled differently.

• Start: castle 30, wall 15 (max 50).
• Win: build your castle to 70, or destroy the enemy castle.
• Your collection and deck do not matter here.
• If both decks run out and both players end their turn without playing a card, the higher castle wins. The end of round 99 is decided the same way.
strings.rulesRoguelike:
Build 20 cards within a budget of 20 points (legendary 4, epic 2, rare 1, common 0) and fight through 12 battles – 3 acts of 4, every fourth is a boss.

• Your castle starts at 30 and carries over between battles; the wall starts fresh each battle.
• You win a battle by destroying the enemy castle, or by building your castle 15 above your maximum (at least 70).
• After a win you get +5 castle and must take 2 new cards (3 and an extra bonus after a boss).
• You can reroll the card offer 3 times per run.
• A loss ends the run.
• If both decks run out and both players end their turn without playing a card, the higher castle wins. The end of round 99 is decided the same way.
strings.rulesCampaign:
Locations full of opponents that you fight with your own 30-card deck.

• Each opponent has their own castle, wall, deck and win target – shown on their card before the fight.
• Some weaken you beforehand: fewer resources, mines, castle or cards in hand.
• The reward is paid only for the first win over each opponent.
• If both decks run out and both players end their turn without playing a card, the higher castle wins. The end of round 99 is decided the same way.

strings.tutGoal: Welcome! There are two ways to win: build your castle to %d, or destroy the enemy castle. Your castle is on the left, the enemy one on the right.
strings.tutCastle: A wall stands in front of each castle. A normal attack breaks the wall first and only then the castle – so building it pays off. Some cards hit the castle directly, though.
strings.tutResources: You pay for cards with resources: Magic, Attack and Stone. The white number on the right of the left panel shows how much of each you have right now. A card's colour tells you what it costs.
strings.tutMines: The gold number on the left of each resource is your mines. That is how much of it you gain at the start of every round.
strings.tutPlayCard: Now play a card: tap one in your hand below that you can afford (it is lit). Hold your finger on a card to look at it first.
strings.tutOpponentTurn: Most cards end your turn when played. Now the opponent plays – the card they played appears in the middle of the battlefield.
strings.tutCombo: Cards marked Combo do not end your turn: you can play another card right after. End the chain with the button at the bottom right.
strings.tutDiscard: A card you do not need? Once per round you can discard it – grab it and drag it up. Discarding does not end your turn.
strings.tutEndTurn: When you have nothing to play or want to save resources, pass with the “%s” button at the bottom right. You draw a card at the start of the next round.
strings.tutDone: That is all you need. This goblin will not last long – build your castle or tear his down. Good luck!
strings.tutMulligan: This is your opening hand. %s costs 11 Attack, so you cannot play it early. Tap it and press Swap.
strings.tutPlayMobilize: Play %s: it costs 1 Magic and gives you 3 Attack. It is a Combo card, so your turn continues.
strings.tutPlayStrike: Now you have 4 Attack. Play %s: it attacks for 11. It breaks the wall first, the rest hits the castle.
strings.tutOpponentAgain: It is the opponent's turn again.
strings.tutWallHit: The opponent damaged your wall. While it stands, your castle is safe. Time to reinforce it.
strings.tutPlayPalisade: Play %s: for 2 Stone it adds 6 wall.
strings.tutOpponentCombo: The opponent played two cards in one turn – the first was a Combo. Your wall held. You draw one card at the start of each round.
strings.tutDiscardMerc: %s has a skull: discard it and you gain 3 Attack. Grab the card and drag it up. You can discard one card per round and it does not end your turn.
strings.tutPlayQuick: You have 5 Attack. Play %s – it is a Combo.
strings.tutPlayOgre: And right after it play %s: it attacks for 9.
strings.tutFinisher: The enemy castle has %1$d left. %2$s hits the castle directly, walls do not stop it. Play it and win!

strings.rulesOnlineSuperRandom:
Both players get a random deck of the same composition, each shuffled differently. The result changes your Super Random rating.

• Start: castle 30, wall 15 (max 50).
• Win: build your castle to 70, or destroy the enemy castle.
• Your collection and deck do not matter here.
• Turns are timed.
• After round 99 the higher castle wins.
strings.rulesOnlineConstructed:
You play your own deck against another player. The result changes your Constructed rating.

• Start: castle 50, wall 15 (max 40).
• Win: build your castle to 100, or destroy the enemy castle.
• You play the deck chosen in the lobby (exactly 30 cards).
• Passive abilities of both players apply.
• Turns are timed.
• After round 99 the higher castle wins.
